summary: Build a Valentine’s Day wish web page with playful Yes/No interaction, celebratory animations on acceptance, and personalized content (message + photos).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Romantic photo-style illustration 1, warm Valentine color grading (valentine-photo-1.dim_1200x800.png)
- Romantic photo-style illustration 2, warm Valentine color grading (valentine-photo-2.dim_1200x800.png)
- Romantic photo-style illustration 3, warm Valentine color grading (valentine-photo-3.dim_1200x800.png)
- Soft bokeh light overlay with sparkles, transparent background (valentine-bokeh-sparkles-overlay.dim_1920x1080.png)

existing_features.title: Update the Valentine landing page to present a clear Valentine’s Day wish prompt with two options: a “Yes” button and a “No” button, replacing the current single CTA button in the hero section.

Implement an evasive/escaping behavior for the “No” button so that when the user tries to click it (hover/tap attempt), it moves away repeatedly and remains difficult to click, encouraging the user to click “Yes”. Use the existing placeholder hook file `frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts` to encapsulate the behavior.

On “Yes” click, show a celebratory overlay that includes a crackers/confetti-style burst plus sparkles/light effects in the background, and then reveal a sweet acceptance message. Implement the celebration visuals in `frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverlay.tsx` (currently empty) and wire it into `frontend/src/features/valentine/ValentinePage.tsx`.

Add a photo section to the Valentine page that displays “some photos” (a small gallery/grid or polaroid-style cards) below the main interaction, using static frontend assets (do not load photos from the backend).

Move all new user-facing copy for the Valentine wish flow (question text, Yes/No labels if customized, sweet acceptance message, and any helper text) into `frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts`, and ensure the Valentine page renders those strings from the config in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Valentine’s Day wish page with a main message and two buttons: Yes and No
Make the 'No' button evade/escape repeatedly so it’s hard to click, encouraging the user to click 'Yes'
On 'Yes' click, show crackers/confetti animation with sparkles/lights in the background
Display a sweet message and include some photos on the page (user-provided)
